description:
Find a texting assistant in AutoMessage's fixed public catalog when the user asks which assistant covers a topic. Accepts a supported topic and returns its catalog id. get_assistant returns the assistant's name, specialty and signup page. The tools cannot send texts, enroll users, access accounts or read conversations.

Returns a catalog id. No background work is started.

topic.description: Choose a topic: workout (Max: Workout), nutrition (Olive: Nutrition), career (Alex: Career Coach), bible (Grace: Bible Reflection), spanish (Sofia: Spanish), french (Camille: French), word (Willa: Word of the day), parenting (Ruth: Parenting), travel (Miles: Travel), anxiety (Maya: Anxiety), stoicism (Marcus: Stoicism), sounding (Sam: Sounding Board), dating (Riley: Dating Advisor), world (Nora: World Brief), money (Penny: Money Coach), portuguese (Ana: Portuguese).
